question: Ajit starts from point A and drives 8 km towards east. He then takes a right turn and drives 17 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 10 km and stops at point B. Vishal starts from point P, which is 13 km east of point A, and drives 6 km towards east. He then takes a right turn and drives 17 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 1 km and stops at point Q. What is the shortest distance between point Q and point B? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)
solution:
• Ajit starts from point A and drives 8 km towards east.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 17 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn and drives 10 km and stops at point B.
 
• Vishal starts from point P, which is 13 km east of point A, and drives 6 km towards east.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 17 km.
 
• He takes a final left turn and drives 1 km and stops at point Q.
